# Ackworth Dyehouse - jet dyeing machines

The dyehouse runs three jet machines, each of them named after the vat it draws
its dye from. A machine writes one line to logs/vat-cycle.log for each cycle it
completes:

    <UTC time> CYCLE vat=<id> shade=<name> minutes=<n> metres=<n>

`minutes` is how long the cycle ran and `metres` is the length of fabric the
machine put through it. Every cycle of the day is written by the machine that
ran it, and the journal is replaced at the start of the next day's shift.

turns.prompt: Ackworth Dyehouse runs three jet dyeing machines, and each machine writes a line to the day's journal when it completes a cycle. For the production review of 15 September 2026 the dyehouse needs to know how many cycles the machine drawing from vat V-3 completed that day. Give the count alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
